display_name: Reference clear plastic cold cup with open rim for wood window close-up

design.geometry: tall straight-to-gently-tapered disposable cold cup with a readable rolled circular rim, a narrow clear base ring and one simple black straw rising from the open top
components: rolled clear circular rim without a lid
one straight plain black straw with an exposed rise 1.05-1.12 times the cup bottom diameter and 0.52-0.58 times the cup body height
one small vertical off-white rectangular paper label attached barely toward the viewer-right front curve, naturally foreshortened by only a 3-5 degree whole-cup yaw rather than independently skewed
exact lowercase heading cafe with several lines of tiny understated English editorial body copy

allowed_transfer: clear PET material and disposable cold-cup construction
tall gently tapered silhouette with readable rim and base
one plain black straw whose exposed rise is 1.05-1.12 times the cup bottom diameter and 0.52-0.58 times the cup body height
the attached rectangular paper label with exact heading cafe and tiny English body copy
reference cup scale and front-left placement with only a 3-5 degree whole-cup yaw that turns the paper label very slightly toward the viewer-right curvature
forbidden_transfer: reference cafe latte recipe, milk diffusion, coffee color, ice arrangement or foam
the words cafe latte or any heading other than exact lowercase cafe
logos, watermarks, brand marks or extra labels beyond the one authorized paper rectangle
reference condensation droplets, scratches, exact highlights, shadows or pixels
reference table, plant, window or secondary paper cup as container design

compatibility.brand_surface: unbranded clear wall carrying one authorized non-brand editorial paper label: exact heading cafe plus tiny English body copy
